detail.longDescription: Like what everybody and everybody's mother is building, we came up with the genius of building a harness. It is a meta harness that beat Prime agent in our latest bench, the tool itself is technically very impressive, although is closed source and offers only 3 free runs, and then 15 USD per month because we are out to do both: 1. Provide Value 2. Make money providing value. Anyway, Should I do a show HN for this. Or is HN way too harsh to self promos and I should find a better angle, like maybe post the technical benchmarks or something better?
